name: Christiansen Orchard and Farm Stand
description: Christiansen Orchard and Farm Stand grows Apples, Peaches, and Pumpkins in Slatersville, RI. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through autumn and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
